name: SB-205384
summary: SB-205384 is an anxiolytic drug. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic.

pharmacology.text: SB-205384 is a GABAA positive allosteric modulator, which binds preferentially to α3, α5, and α6 subunit containing subtypes.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: SB-205384 does not switch GABA-A receptors on by itself. It makes the receptor's response to GABA last longer, which is a different trick from the one benzodiazepines use.
fact.zh: SB-205384 本身不會啟動 GABA-A 受體，而是讓受體對 GABA 的反應持續更久，這和苯二氮平的作用方式不同。
fact.zhHans: SB-205384 本身不会启动 GABA-A 受体，而是让受体对 GABA 的反应持续更久，这和苯二氮平的作用方式不同。
